def _fixture_scope_check(fixture_scope):
    wrapper = _copy(fixture_scope)
    _closed(wrapper, ('scope', 'scope_pin'), 'E_FIXTURE_SCOPE')
    scope = _closed(wrapper['scope'], FIXTURE_SCOPE_KEYS, 'E_FIXTURE_SCOPE')
    _require(type(scope['schema_version']) is int and scope['schema_version'] == 1 and
             scope['record_type'] == 'Root_I7_one_use_owned_temp_IO_fixture_scope' and
             scope['author'] == '/root' and scope['Root_thread'] == ROOT_THREAD and
             scope['owned_namespace'] == FIXTURE_NAMESPACE and scope['case_manifest'] == CASE_MANIFEST and
             type(scope['hard_timeout_seconds']) is int and scope['hard_timeout_seconds'] == 60 and
             type(scope['metadata_cap']) is int and scope['metadata_cap'] == SOURCE_CAP and
             scope['operational_authority'] is False and scope['original_project_target_execution'] is False and
             scope['owned_I7_synthetic_IO_execution'] is True, 'E_FIXTURE_SCOPE')
    start, end, born = (_ticks6(scope[k]) for k in ('interval_start', 'interval_end', 'created_utc'))
    now = current_ticks()
    _require(born <= start <= now and now + 600000000 < end and end - start <= 36000000000,
             'E_FIXTURE_TIME')
    for key in ('publisher_source', 'fixture_source', 'API', 'Source_review_Root_adoption'):
        p = _pin(scope[key])
        _require(p['path'].startswith(SOURCE_DIRECTORY + '\\'), 'E_FIXTURE_SCOPE')
    _require(scope['publisher_source']['path'] == MODULE_PATH and scope['fixture_source']['path'] == FIXTURE_PATH and
             scope['API']['path'] == API_PATH, 'E_FIXTURE_SOURCE')
    pin = _pin(wrapper['scope_pin'])
    _require(pin['path'].startswith(P10_DIRECTORY + '\\') and
             not pin['path'].startswith(FIXTURE_NAMESPACE + '\\'), 'E_FIXTURE_SCOPE')
    return wrapper
Source_evidence.build_finite8_prewrite_metadata_plan:
def build_finite8_prewrite_metadata_plan(*, request, selected_rows, draft_material, output_paths):
    """Pure structural slice. No I0/lease/producer/proof admission or filesystem I/O."""
    request = _copy(request)
    _closed(request, SCHEMAS['batch_request21_v2']['keys'])
    _require(type(request['schema_version']) is int and request['schema_version'] == 2 and
             request['record_type'] == SCHEMAS['batch_request21_v2']['record_type'] and
             request['author'] == '/root' and type(request['Root_thread']) is str and
             re.fullmatch('[0-9a-f]{8}(?:-[0-9a-f]{4}){3}-[0-9a-f]{12}', request['Root_thread']) is not None and
             type(request['request_id']) is str and 0 < len(request['request_id']) <= 128 and
             request['source_only'] is True and request['canonical_publication_selected'] is True and
             request['operational_authority'] is False and request['target_execution'] is False, 'E_REQUEST')
    _ticks6(request['created_utc'])
    _path(request['publication_receipt_path'])
    registry = {}
    _support(request['current_owner_support'], OWNER_SUPPORT_KEYS, registry)
    _support(request['Root_future_path_selection_support'], ('subject', 'different_review', 'Root_adoption'), registry)
    _support(request['new_lease_support'], LEASE_SUPPORT_KEYS, registry)
    _support(request['predecessor_inventory_support'], ('subject', 'different_review', 'Root_adoption'), registry)
    _closed(request['producer_supports'], ('M3',), 'E_PRODUCER')
    _support(request['producer_supports']['M3'], ('Source', 'API', 'different_review', 'Root_adoption'), registry)
    for key in ('publisher_source', 'publisher_API', 'publisher_Source_review', 'publisher_Root_adoption'):
        _register(registry, request[key])
    rows = request['rows']
    _require(type(rows) is list and 0 < len(rows) <= 8 and all(type(r) is dict for r in rows), 'E_ROWS')
    roles = [r.get('role') for r in rows]
    _require(all(type(r) is str and r in ROLE_ORDER for r in roles) and len(set(roles)) == len(roles) and
             roles == [r for r in ROLE_ORDER if r in roles], 'E_ROLE_ORDER')
    _require(type(selected_rows) is list and len(selected_rows) == len(rows) and
             type(draft_material) is dict and set(draft_material) == set(roles), 'E_SELECTED')
    selected_rows = _json(_wire({'rows': selected_rows}))['rows']
    outputs = []
    candidates = []
    for item, selected in zip(rows, selected_rows):
        _closed(item, SCHEMAS['batch_request_row10_v2']['keys'])
        _closed(selected, SELECTED_ROW_KEYS, 'E_SELECTED')
        _require(item['role'] == selected['role'] and item['canonical_path'] == selected['canonical_path'] and
                 type(item['source_cap']) is int and item['source_cap'] == selected['source_cap'] == PHASE_CAP and
                 type(selected['selected_ordinal']) is int and selected['selected_ordinal'] > 18 and
                 selected['must_change_Source_bytes'] is True and
                 item['metadata_Source_worker'] == selected['preparation_Source_author'] and
                 item['retained_semantic_Source_author'] == selected['retained_semantic_Source_author'] and
                 item['physical_Source_editor'] == '/root', 'E_SELECTED')
        for actor in (item['metadata_Source_worker'], item['retained_semantic_Source_author']):
            _require(type(actor) is str and 0 < len(actor) <= 256, 'E_ACTOR')
        draft = _register(registry, item['draft'], PHASE_CAP)
        _require(draft['path'] == selected['draft_path'], 'E_DRAFT')
        predecessor = _register(registry, selected['predecessor'], PHASE_CAP)
        for key in ('author_receipt', 'source_review', 'Root_adoption'):
            _register(registry, item[key])
        body = draft_material[item['role']]
        _require(type(body) is bytes and 0 < len(body) <= PHASE_CAP and len(body) == draft['bytes'] and
                 sha(body) == draft['sha256'] and sha(body) != predecessor['sha256'], 'E_DRAFT')
        canonical = _path(item['canonical_path'])
        outputs.extend([canonical, canonical + '.staging'])
        candidates.append({'role': item['role'], 'declared_candidate': dict(path=canonical, bytes=len(body), sha256=sha(body)),
                           'predecessor': predecessor, 'draft': draft})
    outputs.extend([request['publication_receipt_path'], request['publication_receipt_path'] + '.staging'])
    _require(type(output_paths) is list and all(type(x) is str for x in output_paths) and
             output_paths == sorted(outputs) and len(set(x.casefold() for x in outputs)) == len(outputs) and
             all(x.casefold() not in registry for x in outputs), 'E_OUTPUTS')
    return MetadataView({'request': request, 'selected_rows': selected_rows, 'declared_candidates': candidates,
                         'output_paths': outputs, 'unwired_semantics': list(UNWIRED_SEMANTICS)})

def construct_publication43(*, record, request):
    """Pure structural constructor over supplied existing evidence. No authority or IO."""
    record = _copy(record)
    request = _copy(request)
    _closed(record, SCHEMAS['batch_publication43_v2']['keys'])
    _closed(request, SCHEMAS['batch_request21_v2']['keys'])
    _require(type(record['schema_version']) is int and record['schema_version'] == 2 and
             record['record_type'] == SCHEMAS['batch_publication43_v2']['record_type'] and
             record['author'] == record['canonical_physical_actor'] == request['author'] == '/root' and
             record['Root_thread'] == request['Root_thread'] and record['request_id'] == request['request_id'] and
             record['verdict'] == PUB_VERDICT and record['canonical_publication'] is True and
             type(record['publication_reserve_seconds']) is int and record['publication_reserve_seconds'] == 60 and
             all(record[k] is False for k in PUBLICATION_FALSE_KEYS) and
             record['partial_failure_preserved_no_rollback_no_automatic_retry'] is True and
             record['canonical_delta_and_creation_review_pending'] is True, 'E_PUBLICATION')
    _require(_ticks6(request['created_utc']) <= _ticks6(record['created_utc']), 'E_CHRONOLOGY')
    registry = {}
    for key in ('actual_Root_request', 'current_owner_scope', 'Root_future_path_selection', 'actual_new_lease',
                'publisher_source', 'publisher_API', 'publisher_different_Source_review', 'publisher_Root_Source_adoption',
                'inherited_Source022_publisher', 'composer_carried'):
        _register(registry, record[key])
    _require(record['actual_Root_request']['path'] != request['publication_receipt_path'], 'E_CYCLE')
    for pubkey, reqkey in (('current_owner_support', 'current_owner_support'),
                          ('Root_future_path_selection_acceptance', 'Root_future_path_selection_support'),
                          ('actual_new_lease_support', 'new_lease_support'),
                          ('predecessor_inventory_support', 'predecessor_inventory_support'),
                          ('producer_supports', 'producer_supports')):
        _require(record[pubkey] == request[reqkey], 'E_PUBLICATION_JOIN')
    for pubkey, reqkey in (('publisher_source', 'publisher_source'), ('publisher_API', 'publisher_API'),
                          ('publisher_different_Source_review', 'publisher_Source_review'),
                          ('publisher_Root_Source_adoption', 'publisher_Root_adoption')):
        _require(record[pubkey] == request[reqkey], 'E_PUBLICATION_JOIN')
    _require(record['current_owner_scope'] == request['current_owner_support']['current_owner_scope'] and
             record['Root_future_path_selection'] == request['Root_future_path_selection_support']['subject'] and
             record['actual_new_lease'] == request['new_lease_support']['canonical'], 'E_PUBLICATION_JOIN')
    _support(request['current_owner_support'], OWNER_SUPPORT_KEYS, registry)
    _support(request['new_lease_support'], LEASE_SUPPORT_KEYS, registry)
    _support(request['Root_future_path_selection_support'], ('subject', 'different_review', 'Root_adoption'), registry)
    _support(request['predecessor_inventory_support'], ('subject', 'different_review', 'Root_adoption'), registry)
    _closed(request['producer_supports'], ('M3',), 'E_PRODUCER')
    _support(request['producer_supports']['M3'], ('Source', 'API', 'different_review', 'Root_adoption'), registry)
    _require(record['topology'] == TOPOLOGY and record['original_numerical_guards'] == ORIGINAL_GUARDS and
             record['immutable_historical_leases'] == HISTORICAL_LEASES and
             record['inherited_Source022_publisher'] == HISTORICAL_PUBLISHER and
             record['inherited_reader_Source_editor'] == '/root/runtime_audit' and
             record['inherited_no_overwrite_writer_Source_editor'] == '/root/m3_source_editor' and
             type(record['publication_helper_physical_Source_editor']) is str, 'E_RETAINED')
    for pin in record['immutable_historical_leases']:
        _register(registry, pin)
    rows = record['published']
    _require(type(rows) is list and 0 < len(rows) <= 8 and type(request['rows']) is list and
             len(rows) == len(request['rows']) and type(record['published_count']) is int and
             record['published_count'] == len(rows), 'E_ROWS')
    roles = []
    for row, req in zip(rows, request['rows']):
        _closed(row, SCHEMAS['batch_published_row_v2']['keys'])
        _closed(req, SCHEMAS['batch_request_row10_v2']['keys'])
        roles.append(row['role'])
        for a, b in (('role', 'role'), ('draft', 'draft'), ('author_receipt', 'author_receipt'),
                     ('exact_Source_review', 'source_review'), ('Root_Source_review_adoption', 'Root_adoption'),
                     ('physical_Source_editor', 'physical_Source_editor'), ('metadata_Source_worker', 'metadata_Source_worker'),
                     ('retained_semantic_Source_author', 'retained_semantic_Source_author'), ('source_cap', 'source_cap')):
            _require(row[a] == req[b] and type(row[a]) is type(req[b]), 'E_ROW_JOIN')
        _require(row['canonical_physical_actor'] == '/root' and type(row['source_cap']) is int and
                 row['source_cap'] == PHASE_CAP, 'E_ROW_JOIN')
        canonical = _register(registry, row['canonical'], PHASE_CAP)
        draft = _register(registry, row['draft'], PHASE_CAP)
        _register(registry, row['predecessor'], PHASE_CAP)
        for key in ('author_receipt', 'exact_Source_review', 'Root_Source_review_adoption'):
            _register(registry, row[key])
        _require(canonical['path'] == req['canonical_path'] and canonical['bytes'] == draft['bytes'] and
                 canonical['sha256'] == draft['sha256'], 'E_ROW_JOIN')
        _physical_pair(row['actual_publication_metadata_APIs'], canonical, PHASE_CAP)
    _require(all(type(r) is str and r in ROLE_ORDER for r in roles) and len(set(roles)) == len(roles) and
             roles == [r for r in ROLE_ORDER if r in roles], 'E_ROLE_ORDER')
    _require(type(record['complete_input_postreads']) is list, 'E_OBSERVATION')
    for obs in record['complete_input_postreads']:
        _require(type(obs) is dict and 'cap' in obs and 'path' in obs and 'bytes' in obs and 'sha256' in obs,
                 'E_OBSERVATION')
        pin = _register(registry, {k: obs[k] for k in ('path', 'bytes', 'sha256')}, obs['cap'])
        _observation(obs, pin, obs['cap'])
    return MetadataView(record)
Source_evidence.construct_reconciliation26:
def construct_reconciliation26(*, record, original_publication, request):
    """No writer: typed postbirth data only. Delta/code/physical semantics remain UNWIRED."""
    record = _copy(record)
    _closed(record, SCHEMAS['reconciliation26_v2']['keys'])
    publication = construct_publication43(record=original_publication, request=request).to_dict()
    _require(type(record['schema_version']) is int and record['schema_version'] == 2 and
             record['record_type'] == SCHEMAS['reconciliation26_v2']['record_type'] and
             record['author'] == '/root' and record['verdict'] == RECON_VERDICT and
             record['canonical_publication'] is True and record['canonical_publication_flag_scope'] == RECON_FLAG_SCOPE and
             all(record[k] is False for k in RECON_FALSE_KEYS), 'E_RECONCILIATION')
    registry = {}
    for key in RECON_PIN_KEYS:
        _register(registry, record[key], PHASE_CAP if key in ('canonical_Source', 'exact_draft_Source') else SOURCE_CAP)
    _require(record['current_owner_scope'] == publication['current_owner_scope'] and
             record['Root_future_path_selection'] == publication['Root_future_path_selection'] and
             record['new_canonical_lease'] == publication['actual_new_lease'] and
             record['prior_actual_publisher_Source'] == publication['publisher_source'] and
             record['initial_actual_Root_request'] == publication['actual_Root_request'] and
             record['prior_publication_created_utc'] == publication['created_utc'], 'E_RECON_JOIN')
    rows = [r for r in publication['published'] if r['canonical'] == record['canonical_Source']]
    _require(len(rows) == 1 and rows[0]['draft'] == record['exact_draft_Source'] and
             _ticks6(request['created_utc']) <= _ticks6(record['canonical_Source_birth_utc']) <=
             _ticks6(record['prior_publication_created_utc']) <= _ticks6(record['created_utc']) and
             type(record['actual_input_observations']) is list, 'E_CHRONOLOGY')
    for obs in record['actual_input_observations']:
        _require(type(obs) is dict and all(k in obs for k in ('path', 'bytes', 'sha256', 'cap')), 'E_OBSERVATION')
        p = _register(registry, {k: obs[k] for k in ('path', 'bytes', 'sha256')}, obs['cap'])
        _observation(obs, p, obs['cap'])
    return MetadataView(record)
